title: Sparkly trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE600">
    <polygon points="18,12 20,18 26,20 20,22 18,28 16,22 10,20 16,18"/>
    <polygon points="82,8 83.5,12 88,13.5 83.5,15 82,19 80.5,15 76,13.5 80.5,12"/>
    <polygon points="12,65 13.5,69 18,70.5 13.5,72 12,76 10.5,72 6,70.5 10.5,69"/>
    <polygon points="88,55 89.5,59 94,60.5 89.5,62 88,66 86.5,62 82,60.5 86.5,59"/>
    <polygon points="72,82 73,85 76,86 73,87 72,90 71,87 68,86 71,85"/>
    <polygon points="28,88 29,91 32,92 29,93 28,96 27,93 24,92 27,91"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="6" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="8" cy="40" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="32" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="94" r="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Mouthpiece -->
  <rect x="10" y="45" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#F5A623" stroke="#FFD280" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="8" y="44" width="5" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Main tube -->
  <rect x="17" y="46" width="30" height="8" rx="3" fill="#E8912D"/>
  <rect x="17" y="46" width="30" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Valves (three pistons) -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="38" width="4" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#D97A1E"/>
    <rect x="26" y="35" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="29" cy="37" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3C4"/>

    <rect x="34" y="37" width="4" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#D97A1E"/>
    <rect x="33" y="34" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3C4"/>

    <rect x="41" y="38" width="4" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#D97A1E"/>
    <rect x="40" y="35" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD280" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="37" r="1.2" fill="#FFF3C4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bell curve / flare -->
  <path d="M47 46 Q58 42 68 34 Q74 29 78 22 Q82 18 86 20 Q90 22 88 30 Q86 40 78 48 Q72 54 64 56 Q56 58 47 54 Z"
        fill="#F5A623" stroke="#FFD280" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Bell opening -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="29" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#FFC940" stroke="#FFE8B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="29" rx="3.5" ry="6" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Highlights on tube -->
  <rect x="20" y="47" width="12" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="38" y="48" width="8" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFF3C4" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Water key / small loop -->
  <path d="M58 54 Q60 58 64 57" fill="none" stroke="#FFD280" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
